text: In 1988 Virginia, teenager Maren Yearly sneaks out to a sleepover and bites through a classmate's finger. Soon after she turns eighteen her father leaves her with cash and a tape about [the hunger that has ruled her since childhood|rules|it must feed], and she sets out to find her mother. On the road she meets other eaters, including Lee, a young man she finds in an Indiana store, and their love grows across [a cross-country drive in a stolen truck|images|vehicles and roads] as she learns [what she has inherited|origin|family blood and inheritance].
